svg.text: PG-1 WIRING: every part goes to the Seed3 socket board (Seed3 pin numbers, seen from outside, USB-C at the bottom)
Coloured line = one wire, soldered to that socket pin. ⏚ = that point goes on a ground chain (black wire, part to part): see the 2 chains at the bottom
Encoders: 3 pins = A, C, B (C is the middle one). The 2 pins on the other side are the push switch. Screen pin 9 (SDO) is not used. Free for later: pins 34, 36, 37 (35 = exp jack later).

The Seed3 itself is never soldered: it plugs into 2 female headers on the socket board. Wires are soldered to the long header legs on the board's back, under heat shrink (mirror image of this view!). Screen ends can be plug-on jumpers.
GROUND CHAINS: one black wire from each point to the next, in this order. Don't join the two chains, and don't loop back.
* the screen GND is a plug-on jumper at the screen end: cut its other end off and solder that end into the chain. (exp jack sleeve joins the audio chain only once the exp jack is used.)
